main_text.before: Under the original split, single-score CADD and AlphaMissense baselines achieved AUC 0.9207 and 0.9470. In the historical fusion audit, the same-hidden-layer \CADDAM{} baseline reached mean AUC 0.9572; adding raw ESM, real PPI-GCN, edge-ablated or permuted representations gave 0.9680, 0.9718, 0.9708 and 0.9694 (Fig. 2B). The historical real-minus-raw fusion interval was positive, while ablated/permuted contrasts included zero (Fig. 2C). Current matched fusion yielded a small real-minus-raw margin ($\Delta$AUC +0.0032, protein 95\% CI [+0.0008, +0.0062]); the ablated contrast remained uncertain. The permutation contrast was small and positive conditional on the sampled graphs (Supplementary Table 12).
main_text.after: Under the original split, single-score CADD and AlphaMissense baselines achieved AUC 0.9207 and 0.9470, respectively. The architecture-matched CADD+AlphaMissense baseline achieved mean AUC 0.9572 and AUPRC 0.9072. Adding raw ESM, edge-ablated FPP, topology-permuted FPP and full FPP yielded mean AUCs of 0.9682, 0.9704, 0.9692 and 0.9716, respectively (Fig. 2B; Supplementary Table 11). On averaged ensemble predictions, full FPP fusion improved over the score baseline by $\Delta$AUC +0.0147 (protein-clustered 95\% CI [+0.0065, +0.0226]) and over raw-ESM fusion by +0.0032 ([+0.0008, +0.0062]). Its margins over edge-ablated fusion (+0.0013, [$-$0.0004, +0.0032]) and topology-permuted fusion (+0.0020, [+0.0001, +0.0045]) were smaller (Fig. 2C; Supplementary Table 12). These results indicate substantial complementarity from protein representations, with a more limited additional contribution from the original STRING topology.

main_text.before: Under the homology-aware split, historical single-fit PPI-GCN exceeded raw ESM (AUC 0.7606 versus 0.7248; Fig. 2D). The retained graph-fusion estimate (0.9741) was lower than the repeated \CADDAM{} baseline (0.9754); raw fusion averaged 0.9728 (Fig. 2E). Current three-seed means were 0.9755 for scores, 0.9727 for raw fusion and 0.9752 for graph fusion. On ensemble predictions, graph-minus-score $\Delta$AUC was +0.0001, CI [-0.0019, +0.0020], and its AUPRC interval also crossed zero. The graph-versus-score effect remained uncertain under homology-aware splitting. Mean metrics and metrics of averaged probabilities can give different close rankings.
main_text.after: Under the homology-aware split, a separate single-fit representation comparison yielded AUC 0.7248 for raw ESM and 0.7606 for full FPP (Fig. 2D). In the matched three-seed fusion comparison, the CADD+AlphaMissense baseline achieved mean AUC 0.9755 and AUPRC 0.8403, compared with 0.9727 and 0.8253 for raw-ESM fusion and 0.9752 and 0.8369 for full-FPP fusion (Fig. 2E; Supplementary Table 11). On ensemble predictions, full-FPP fusion exceeded raw-ESM fusion by $\Delta$AUC +0.0027 (protein-clustered 95\% CI [+0.0015, +0.0040]), but its difference from the strong score baseline was +0.0001 ([$-$0.0019, +0.0020]; Supplementary Table 12). Thus, graph fusion provided a positive increment over raw-embedding fusion without establishing a clear additional benefit over CADD+AlphaMissense under homology-aware splitting. The test-set positive rate differed between the original and homology-aware splits (31.95\% versus 10.56\%; Fig. 2F), limiting direct cross-split AUPRC comparison.

main_text.before: ESM representation space showed modest correspondence with PPI topology. Neighbour pairs had mean cosine similarity 0.8789 versus 0.8639 for random pairs; within-community similarity also exceeded between-community similarity (Fig. 3A). Graph-associated gains were non-monotonic: mid-k-core variants showed $\Delta$AUC +0.0775, whereas high-degree variants showed -0.0178. Betweenness, clustering and neighbour-risk profiles varied across strata (Fig. 3B--D).
main_text.after: ESM protein representations showed modest correspondence with PPI topology. Directly connected protein pairs had a mean cosine similarity of 0.8789, compared with 0.8639 for randomly paired proteins; within-community similarity also exceeded between-community similarity (Fig. 3A). Performance differences between fixed PPI-GCN propagation and raw ESM varied non-monotonically across network strata. For example, mid-k-core variants showed a $\Delta$AUC of +0.0775, whereas high-degree variants showed $-$0.0178 (Fig. 3B). Betweenness, clustering and neighbour-risk strata also exhibited heterogeneous performance differences (Fig. 3C,D).

main_text.before: Exploratory joint maps included both positive and negative profiles, such as mid-k-core/high-betweenness ($\Delta$AUC +0.1429) and high-k-core/low-clustering (-0.0532; Fig. 3E/F). All 53 joint cells and highlighted profiles were inspected on the same test set. Their variant-resampled intervals do not account for protein dependence or post-hoc selection. These observations identify hypotheses for independent validation rather than confirmed benefiting subgroups.
main_text.after: Among 53 joint topology cells examined on the same test set, we observed both positive and negative performance differences, including mid-k-core/high-betweenness ($\Delta$AUC +0.1429) and high-k-core/low-clustering ($\Delta$AUC $-$0.0532; Fig. 3E,F). Because the highlighted cells were selected after examining the test-set results and their intervals were computed using variant-level resampling, these estimates do not account for within-protein dependence or subgroup-selection uncertainty. We therefore interpret these patterns as exploratory findings that require independent validation.
